explore.about.body:
**About *Explore with MWNF***  
  
Initially, the purpose of the *Explore with MWNF* website was to create a new opportunity to survey the monuments and archaeological sites housed in the MWNF archives and database, all compiled by local specialists and presented from the perspective of the country to be visited. The material that had been gathered for the *Islamic Art in the Mediterranean* Exhibition Trails and related travel books served as the cornerstone for this website. Monuments from other MWNF databases have been added over time, namely *Discover Islamic Art*, *Discover Baroque Art* and our extensive documentation of the cultural heritage of Portugal.  
  
*Explore with MWNF* is now ready for further development and we are looking forward to welcoming new partners and to creating new digital travel opportunities together. Click [Get Involved](https://explore.museumwnf.org/get-involved) if you are interested to know more.  
  
Our target groups include people who do not want to or cannot travel physically and people who are looking for art discovery travel ideas. We also cater to people who are simply interested in cultural heritage as well as scholars and students, who will find a great deal of information that isn’t available anywhere else.  
  
*Explore with MWNF* uses English as its main navigation language and we are doing our best to publish all texts in English. Since translations are done by volunteers, we are not always in the position to guarantee simultaneous publication of English alongside the original language. If you are interested in helping with translations or copy editing, please send your CV and availability to [office@museumwnf.net](<mailto: office@museumwnf.net>).  
  
In this context we would like to apologise to all users and visitors who would prefer other languages than English. We are aware that the recognition of cultural diversity starts with the recognition of linguistic diversity. But we had only two options: adopt English as our main language or forget about the *Explore with MWNF* website.  
  
The locations and monuments presented are of great artistic, cultural and historical relevance. Our priorities, however, are places that are less known – normally because no or only very poor information is accessible to non-experts. All texts published have been compiled by local experts and curated to provide accurate information with a genuine understanding of people who love the place they study. If you wish to comment on texts published on *Explore*, please contact [editing@museumwnf.net](<mailto: editing@museumwnf.net>).  
  
*Explore with MWNF* offers three paths for discovery:  
  
**Explore by Theme**  
For visitors with interested in a specific theme.  
Within each Theme, navigation is Country-based.  
  
**Explore by Country**  
Here visitors have access to all materials available in the MWNF database and archives.  
  
**Explore by Itinerary**  
In this path we take our visitors on a real digital tour.  
You can start by selecting first a Country and then the related Itineraries or you can directly select from the list of Itineraries.  
  
***Explore with MWNF* Terminology**  
**Theme:** specific focus of a project in the ‘Explore by Theme’ path.  
**Country:** countries represented in *Explore*.  
**Territory:** specific regions within countries; this can be officially defined regions as foreseen in the territorial organisation of the country or territories that have been defined for specific *Explore*\-related purposes.  
**Location:** cities, villages or other unites to define the geographic location of a monument, archaeological site, etc.  
**Monument:** this term is used to indicate any type of monument but also other places presented.  
**Itinerary:** virtual travels; most so far published Itineraries are based on the MWNF Exhibition Trails and related Travel Books. Each Itinerary is organised in Sub-Itineraries.  
**Sub-Itinerary:** Sub-division of Itineraries.  
**Get Directions:** here users find contact details, directions to a location and other related information.  
**Related Content:** If the MWNF database includes more than one Description, it can be found under Related Content. Information about the source is provided.  
  
Museum With No Frontiers (MWNF) is a non-profit organisation relying to a large extend on volunteer resources. Our team is composed of people from all over the world who are passionate about history, art and cultural heritage. The MWNF website was first launched in 2005, in cooperation with museums from 14 countries; click [here](https://islamicart.museumwnf.org/pm_partner_list.php?type=museum) to view our co-founding museums.  
  
**About the logos published on *Explore with MWNF***  
  
**Barakat Trust**  
The development of this website, namely the components concerning the Islamic heritage of the Mediterranean, could count on the support of Barakat Trust.  
  
**European Union**  
The development of *Islamic Art/Heritage in the Mediterranean* and *Discover Islamic Art*\-related contents as well as the development of the nucleus of this website had been realised with the support of the European Union, within two major projects carried out in two consecutive periods: 1998 to 2001/3 and 2004 to 2007.  
  
**Turismo de Portugal**  
All MWNF projects carried out in Portugal could count on the support of Turismo de Portugal. The Exhibition Trail *The Manueline. Portuguese Art during the Great Discoveries* was a joint MWNF / Turismo de Portugal project.  
  
**Tyrol & Innsbruck**  
The MWNF pilot project – the Tyrolean Exhibition Trails *Gothic Art*, *Baroque and Rococo*, *Maximilian I* – was set up between 1994 and 1996, in cooperation with Tirol Werbung and the Innsbruck Tourism Board. The innovative combination of cultural heritage and tourism potentials inspired then the development of similar offers all around the Mediterranean.  
  
**Copyright information**  
Click [here](https://www.museumwnf.org/mwnf_credit.php) for details.

explore.credits.body:
**Credits for the material published on this website**  
  
For text-related credits please refer to the relevant pages, namely Historical Background and Descriptions for locations and monuments. All texts published on this website have been compiled by authors appointed by our local partners.  
  
Image credits are included on the image itself, normally at the bottom right. For the majority of the images, copyright is held by Museum With No Frontiers (MWNF).  
  
This applies to material published under Explore by Theme, Explore by Country and Explore by Itinerary. In addition, under Explore by Itinerary, information about the composition of our local project teams can be found. Further details about translators and copy editors can be found at the end of the text or under the heading ‘Credits for the Explore with MWNF website’.  
  
Kindly note that it is not allowed to use or reproduce texts or images published on this website without prior written authorisation of MWNF. For any questions about this policy, please contact [office@museumwnf.net](<mailto: office@museumwnf.net>).

explore.getInvolved.body:
**Get Involved in *Explore with MWNF***  
  
There are many different possibilities to get involved in *Explore with MWNF*. On this page you will find a selection of options but please feel free to contact us at [office@museumwnf.net](<mailto: office@museumwnf.net>) and tell us about your ideas. We look forward to hearing from you!  
  
**You represent a local authority, a territorial entity or are in charge of a monument** and are interested to know about the possibility of participating in *Explore with MWNF*: Please contact [management@museumwnf.net](<mailto: management@museumwnf.net>).  
  
For the following options please contact [office@museumwnf.net](<mailto: office@museumwnf.net>):  
  
**You are an individual scholar or researcher** and would like to publish on *Explore with MWNF*: We can evaluate the proposal only if the local entity in charge of the monument/site has approved the work and authorises its publication on *Explore with MWNF*. The name(s) of the author(s) of texts and images will be mentioned on the website; copyright is transferred to MWNF.  
  
**You are an individual scholar or researcher** and are interested in contributing, on a volunteer basis, to the further development of the *Explore with MWNF* website by adding curatorially accurate information about monuments and sites: This is possible but requires an authorisation from the local entity in charge of the monuments and sites concerned. Name(s) of the author(s) of texts and images will be mentioned on the website; copyright is transferred to MWNF.  
  
**You are a photographer, translator or copy-editor** and are interested in volunteer opportunities, within the context of *Explore with MWNF*.  
  
**You are a person passionate about cultural heritage, art and travelling** and just want to help.

explore.importantInformation.body:
**Important Information**  
  
This search tool allows searching for monuments and archaeological sites in the MWNF Database.  
  
Currently, major thematic focuses are (monuments and sites in the Database):  
Islamic heritage in the Mediterranean region (about 1500)  
Baroque heritage in central Europe (about 300)  
Manueline heritage in Portugal (about 200).  
  
Other focal points:  
Islamic heritage in India, namely Hyderabad and Lucknow  
Italy, Latium, Castelli Romani, Ariccia  
  
The Database is growing constantly and new monuments and sites are added every year. Updates are published on this page.  
  
Users can choose between two Search options:  
  
**MWNF Database Search** (results are based on our internal search tool; recommended for searches related to curatorial work and for users with specific interest).  
  
**Google-powered Search** (this custom search tool enhanced by Google covers also related content such as related MWNF publications, introduction texts, etc; recommended for more generic searches).  
  
We are interested to receive your feedback and look forward to hearing from you at [office@museumwnf.net](<mailto: office@museumwnf.net>).

explore.whatsNew.body:
**What’s new**  
  
Welcome to the entirely redesigned ***Explore with MWNF*** website!  
  
You may notice that much has changed from our previous version. Having redesigned and reorganised, we now offer three main navigation options: Explore by Theme, Explore by Country, and Explore by Itinerary.  
  
***Explore by Itinerary***  
  
All Itineraries are based on our travel books and on the visiting programme designed by the authors.  
  
Eleven Itineraries take you to eleven countries surrounding the Mediterranean and invite you to explore the artistic legacy of Islam and get familiar with the specific understanding of art and architecture by the great Islamic dynasties, from the Umayyad Caliphate (41/661–132/750) until the Ottoman Empire (699/1299–1340/1922).  
  
Portugal is represented with a second Itinerary dedicated to ‘The Manueline’, a uniquely Portuguese art embodying the symbiosis of European art with an aesthetic that is strongly influenced by Portugal’s great discoveries under the reign of King D. Manuel I, ‘The Fortunate’ (O Venturoso) at the end of the 15th and beginning of the 16th century.  
  
***Explore by Theme***  
  
Two new Themes welcome visitors to little known masterpieces and highlights of Baroque Art and to the amazingly diversified cultural legacy of the Austrian alpine region of Tyrol.  
  
Enjoy a new travel experience with ***Explore with MWNF***!
